first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for Historic England NHLE List Entry 1495589 (Exeter Central Station, Exeter). Historic England's official NHLE record identifies Exeter Central Station as a Grade II railway station first listed on 24 July 2026, and official NHLE polygon metadata states that listed-building polygons are available for buildings listed or substantively amended since 4 April 2011 and that polygon area is populated where a building footprint has been mapped. The selected exact layer-3 GeoJSON query for ListEntry 1495589 was not retrievable before any feature payload or polygon coordinates could be read; no geometry was inferred or fabricated, so no individual building record was accepted.
